title: India Urges Nationals in Saudi Arabia to Follow Safety Directives
detail: India urged its nationals in Saudi Arabia to follow local safety directives amid security concerns, as Houthi attacks on the kingdom continue.

media.caption: India urges nationals in Saudi Arabia to follow safety directives

title: Egyptian Parliament to Discuss Defensive Aid to Saudi Arabia
detail: Egypt's parliament is set to discuss defensive aid to Saudi Arabia, following President Sisi's request for authorisation of defence assistance.
